# Proposal

## Why

Retained OpenSpec task lists and KBD summaries still advertise completed source and deliveries as unfinished. The operator requests evidence-based reconciliation after 2.2.38 without repeating builds or passing operations.

## What Changes

- Map older delivery tasks to existing immutable source and operation receipts; archive only satisfied scopes and sync their retained specifications.
- Keep unproved predicates open with explicit qualification or superseded-scope notes, including all eighteen original portfolio qualification tasks.
- Reconcile the closed convergence phase's enclosing run through supported typed KBD commands and correct authored current-status prose. Preserve generated-file ownership, journal history, clocks and independent completion markers.
- Commit and push the reconciliation on the consolidated main branches.

## Capabilities

No new or modified product capabilities. This administrative change opts out of delta specs; historical capability synchronization belongs to the original changes.

## Impact

OpenSpec artifacts, evidence indexes and KBD administrative state in The Boss and the LibreFang convergence initiative. No application/runtime code, dependency pins, credentials, builds, publication or installed-operation changes.

# Design

## Context

The canonical phase is complete at revision 705 while its enclosing run still says running. Separate markers retain code 61/61 tasks and 20/20 changes, versus qualification 43/61 terminal (42 passed, one skipped duplicate). Older Boss lists contain 87 unchecked boxes across eighteen changes; initiative lists retain exactly eighteen unqualified tasks.

## Goals / Non-Goals

Reconcile retained evidence at its original scope and revision. Do not infer native Windows acceptance, new-candidate acceptance, full harness compatibility or broader representation/federation qualification from source completion or a later package.

## Decisions

Use disjoint evidence owners for product and initiative OpenSpec roots. Preserve each original predicate; source-complete alone cannot satisfy a mixed operation task. Missing evidence remains pending. Archive via OpenSpec with explicit main-spec synchronization; retain original history and document superseded prescriptions instead of fabricating their execution.

Use typed KBD decisions and independent completion records. The installed CLI has no run-complete command: retire the already administratively closed enclosing run through its supported cancellation command if no complete-run surface exists, naming administrative retirement rather than product failure. Keep the phase complete and qualification partial; do not create a successor run. Never hand-edit generated waypoint, position or progress files.

## Risks / Trade-offs

Older task lists combine implementation and qualification; preserve unproved requirements even when that prevents archiving a whole change. Generated run status can differ from phase status; the receipt and current prose must explain both rather than claim full certification.

## Migration Plan

Record pre-reconciliation hashes and canonical counts, retain archived files, apply supported commands, then compare task identities and final counts. Rollback is the preserved Git history and append-only journal; do not rewrite events. One completed documentation/evidence consistency review is sufficient. No builds or passing product operations run.

# Historical OpenSpec reconciliation after 2.2.38

Recorded 2026-10-14. This administrative reconciliation uses retained evidence and source inspection. No application build, passing operation, effect or approval cycle was repeated. Historical code remains **61/61 tasks and 20/20 changes**. Portfolio qualification remains **43/61 terminal: 42 qualified and one skipped historical duplicate**. Its **18 outstanding manual qualification items** remain in the [manual certification handoff](https://github.com/GQAdonis/librefang/blob/main/docs/plans/agent-fabric-convergence/manual-certification-handoff.md).

The original Boss inventory had 18 active historical changes and 87 unchecked task boxes. Nine bounded historical scopes are now archived through supported `openspec archive`; nine original changes remain active with **65 unchecked boxes**, plus the separately tracked administrative reconciliation change. These local boxes are not 65 new canonical code tasks and do not replace either original marker.

## Evidence conventions

Initiative receipts live in `GQAdonis/librefang`, under `docs/plans/agent-fabric-convergence`. Linked repository paths remain portable after checkout consolidation. Receipt source revisions, timestamps and digests remain unchanged. Retired Cadence/worktree paths inside original receipts are historical provenance, not instructions to recreate them. The [IPFS history index](https://github.com/GQAdonis/librefang/blob/main/docs/plans/agent-fabric-convergence/cadence-history-ipfs.md) preserves archived-history retrieval.

A historical Mac operation covers only its recorded predicates, inputs and platform. It is not reassigned to 2.2.38, Windows, model-strength compliance or another profile. The accepted core 2.2.32 candidate and both operator acceptance records remain separate. [2.2.38 operation](../../build/release-operation-2.2.38/operation.json) and [publication](../../build/release-operation-2.2.38/publication.json) retain current-release identities and limits. Native Windows installed operation and operator acceptance of 2.2.38 remain pending.

## Specification and accounting disposition

The supported archive CLI synchronized five new main specifications: lifecycle overview (3 requirements), Teams in Work (2), reusable teams (5), practical presets (3) and local UAR delivery (3). Existing requirement statements were retained. Missing new-capability Purpose sections were supplied from source-backed scope; the lifecycle delta received three faithful scenario blocks without weakening statements. No existing main-spec Purpose was overwritten. Four scope-only/no-delta archives explicitly skipped spec synchronization and preserved their authored documents.

Archive adds no runtime conformance, portfolio task pass, phase completion or Cadence delivery. Failures, cancelled runs and unknown accounting are preserved. Cadence remains retired with 17 historical deliveries; clocks/history/publication records are not reset or recreated. KBD generated-state reconciliation is separately owned by the initiative coordinator. Representation, unused connectors, mobile/cloud/federation and comparative scenarios remain operator-owned.

See the initiative's `manual-certification-handoff.md` for pending qualification.
